description: This file implements graph deduplication functionality within TorchDynamo for optimizing computational graphs by identifying and merging identical subgraphs. Key components include subgraph creation, replacement, dependency management, cycle detection, and aliasing checks, enabling efficient graph optimization in PyTorch models.

methods.name: dict[str,torch.fx.GraphModule] apply_graph_deduplication(output_graph)
methods.description: Main entry point to apply graph deduplication on the provided output_graph. Performs subgraph creation and replacement in two phases, returning a map of subgraph modules.

methods.name: None _replace_region_with_subgraph( graph: torch.fx.Graph, region: Region, get_subgraph_node: Node, external_node_usages: Iterable[OrderedSet[UsageIndex]], node_usage_to_tuple_elems: dict[UsageIndex, OrderedSet[int]], ind_to_tuple_spec: dict[int, dict[tuple[int, ...], int]], inds_with_external_users: list[int], subgraph_name: str, node_to_additional_deps: dict[Node, OrderedSet[Node]], node_to_mutated_arg_positions: dict[Node, OrderedSet[int]], )
methods.description: Replaces a specified region in the graph with a subgraph node, handling output replacements and node erasure.

methods.name: tuple[torch.fx.Graph,list[OrderedSet[UsageIndex]],dict[UsageIndex,OrderedSet[int]],dict[int,dict[tuple[int,...],int]],] _create_subgraph( region: Region, inds_with_external_users: list[int], )
methods.description: Constructs a subgraph from a region, handling external inputs, output flattening, and tensor tuple outputs.

methods.name: bool _stable_topological_sort_impl( graph: torch.fx.Graph, node_to_additional_deps: dict[Node, OrderedSet[Node]], do_sort: bool = True, )
methods.description: Performs a topological sort of graph nodes, considering dependencies to ensure correct order.

methods.name: None _stable_topological_sort( graph: torch.fx.Graph, node_to_additional_deps: dict[Node, OrderedSet[Node]], )
methods.description: Wrapper for _stable_topological_sort_impl to enforce acyclic ordering.

methods.name: bool _has_cycle( graph: torch.fx.Graph, node_to_additional_deps: dict[Node, OrderedSet[Node]], )
methods.description: Detects cycles within the graph dependencies.

methods.name: dict[Node,OrderedSet[Node]] _populate_additional_deps( graph: torch.fx.Graph, node_to_mutated_arg_positions: dict[Node, OrderedSet[int]] )
methods.description: Builds a dependency graph considering mutation and global state dependencies.

methods.name: None _add_global_state_dependencies( graph: torch.fx.Graph, node_to_additional_deps: dict[Node, OrderedSet[Node]] )
methods.description: Adds dependencies based on global states like autocasting, ensuring correct ordering.

methods.name: None _add_mutation_dependencies( node_to_mutated_arg_positions: dict[Node, OrderedSet[int]], node_to_additional_deps: dict[Node, OrderedSet[Node]], )
methods.description: Adds dependencies for nodes involved in input mutation to maintain order.

methods.description: Checks for tensor aliasing conflicts within a region, including input-output and input-input aliasing.

methods.name: bool _is_tuple_node(node: Node)
methods.description: Determines if a node represents a tuple based on its example value.

methods.name: Generator[Node,None,None] _get_children_getitems(node: Node)
methods.description: Finds getitem nodes that are children of a given node, used for flattening.

methods.name: OrderedSet[int] _get_flattened_node_indices(node: Node, region: Region)
methods.description: Returns indices of nodes in a region that are part of flattened tuples.
